test_title: PYST 198: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 25th Nov,, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Sharada was cooking lunch / when I am going / to give her / the mobile phone.
solution:
The correct answer is '**when I am going**', i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's take a look at the sentence. The given sentence is a hybrid sentence where it is using two tenses simulateneously.
 
• **Past continuous tense: **We use the past continuous to talk about events and temporary states that were in progress around a certain time in the past.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• Subject+ was + The -ing form of verb.
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• At 4 pm last Tuesday, I was working in the office.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Simple past tense: **We use the past simple to talk about events, states or habits at definite times in the past.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• Subject+ was + The second form of verb.
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• At 4 pm last Monday, I finished work early and went home.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• The given sentence depicted that during an action of a past at a particular time a different action happened. Thus, to show the second action, since it also happened in past it will be written in simple past because it doesn't have any relation with present or future.
 
• Therefore, 'am going' needs to be replaced with 'went'.

Correct sentence:__ *Sharada was cooking lunch **when I __went__** to give her the mobile phone.*
